what: Vertical-stack budgets for biomes/swouterwall (South-Western Outer Wall rmwvsqhhqyk3f annealed with northern Region 177 rmwzq42zszc94 + Trigemini Pass rmwvsmgi8xrro): 4 station HTML pages (< 2.0 MB each via swouterwall.tex.js sidecar), max samplers <= 14 (< 13 on MAT_GROUND), and estimated VRAM <= 380 MB.

swouterwall.html.why: Station 1 (boreallakes, +3,040 m, 1.10 atm): stepped Boreal Paternoster Lakes, boulder riffle, Tarn Spire-Spruce, Fur Larch & Quaking Sphagnum rafts with sidecar textures.

swouterwall-morainetarn.html.why: Station 2 (morainetarn, +4,360 m, 0.91 atm): glacial-flour Turquoise Moraine Tarn, Stone-Pine krummholz, Silver-Peel Moraine Birch & KFROST stone rings with sidecar textures.

swouterwall-trigemini.html.why: Station 3 (trigemini, +5,680 m, 0.76 atm): 3-trough Trigemini Pass junction, half-frozen Cold Tarn with WATER.ice shore shelves, Lungcushion O2 domes & Dalab way-cairns.

swouterwall-breathvale.html.why: Station 4 (breathvale, +6,100 m, 0.69->0.58 atm): Southern Hanging Breath-Vale & < 0.60 atm hypoxia headwall ceiling with Sunblood Crust & frozen rime seep.

*.why: Shared swouterwall.tex.js texture sidecar pack (swouterwall + nwouterwall & copperglacier kin slices) serving all four station pages.
